headline: BG Q2 Deep Dive: Global Platform, Viterra Integration, and Margin Tailwinds Shape Outlook
summary: Global agribusiness company Bunge Global (NYSE:BG) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 88.3% year on year to $24.04 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2 per share was 2.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
